caption:
Apple is finally bringing its AI tools to China starting with a November beta, working with local partners like Alibaba to make it happen. Big tech can never just launch a product globally anymore without playing local politics first. Would you trust your phone's AI to summarize your work texts?

@apple

Source: The Verge

post.news: Apple is bringing Apple Intelligence to China in December with iOS 27.3, starting with a beta on November 4th.
post.take: Apple finally cracked the China market by bringing it basic writing tools and notification summaries. Tim Cook discovered the secret to geopolitics is spellcheck.
post.insight: Even the biggest tech brands have to localize their AI features piece by piece to play nice with local rules and partners.
